ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C1-1,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 24-G
in the area bound by:

West 95'" Street; South Vincennes Avenue; West 97" Street; the alley next west of and
parallel to South Vincennes Avenue; West 96" Street; and the vacated alley and alley
next west of and parallel to South Vincennes Avenue,

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
